versions.subject: HTTP Request Smuggling (#3731)
versions.detection: `suricata` (http.request_headers{}.name="*Content-Length*" http.request_headers{}.name="*Transfer-Encoding*") OR (http.request_headers{}.name="*Content-Length*" http.request_headers{}.value="*Transfer-Encoding*") OR (http.request_headers{}.value="*Content-Length*" http.request_headers{}.name="*Transfer-Encoding*") OR (http.request_headers{}.name="*Content-Length*" http.request_headers{}.value="0") | rename dest_ip as dest | rex field=_raw "request_headers.:\[(?<headers>.*)\]" | stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by dest, dest_port, src_ip, http.url, http.http_method, http.http_user_agent, http.protocol, http.status, headers | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | `http_possible_request_smuggling_filter`

versions.subject: Add YAML Formatting Job (#3889)
versions.detection:
`suricata` (http.request_headers{}.name="*Content-Length*" http.request_headers{}.name="*Transfer-Encoding*") OR (http.request_headers{}.name="*Content-Length*" http.request_headers{}.value="*Transfer-Encoding*") OR (http.request_headers{}.value="*Content-Length*" http.request_headers{}.name="*Transfer-Encoding*") OR (http.request_headers{}.name="*Content-Length*" http.request_headers{}.value="0")

       http.protocol, http.status, headers
